title: A Seal Pup Is Fed for Just 4 Days. Then It's Done

scenes.text: A mother seal feeds her pup for just four days.
That is the shortest nursing period of any mammal.
Her milk is over 60 percent fat, the richest of any mammal.
A newborn of about 24 kilograms almost doubles in those four days.
Males of this species inflate a pink balloon from their nose to fight for mates.
Four days of milk. That's all it gets.

description:
A mother hooded seal nurses her pup for only about four days, the shortest nursing period of any mammal.
Her milk is over 60 percent fat, and the pup, about 24 kilograms at birth, nearly doubles in weight before weaning.
Would you rather have four days of food or four days of anything? Comment below.
first_comment: Bonus: the hood is a nasal sac, and the pink balloon is an elastic septum pushed out through one nostril. Would you have wanted to see that in person?
